CustomField.label: Turn Phases (ms, JSON)
CustomField.description: Where this turn's server-side time went: {turnMs, setup, resolveServers, loadTools, buildPrompt, modelLoop}. LatencyMs__c is the modelLoop phase only — it starts after setup, MCP tool loading and prompt building have already run, so a turn reporting 888ms had really taken 9.5s and the difference was invisible from either end. turnMs is the whole server-side turn; the caller's wall clock minus turnMs is network and persistence. Only populated on Role = Assistant.
